contexts: app-based EPA assessments, minimum 12 per rotation
competency committee target review in June
reading: The target of 12 assessments per rotation sits between two groups with different workloads: residents who must request and collect assessments, and assessors who must observe, rate and write. The retrieved studies connect the target to strategic requesting by residents (c1) and to late, memory-based completion by assessors (c5), and link delay to thinner comments (c2). Chief residents and administrators see the system from the middle and the edge, and struggling residents may request the fewest assessments. The committee's June decision depends on understanding these mechanisms, which the app export alone cannot show.
